Applicant seeks a Zoning Change from B3-1 to B2-3 to allow the construction of a
proposed 5-story 20-unit mixed use building. The Applicant will provide 18 on site in
door garage parking spaces. There will be approximately 2,078 sq. ft. of commercial
space on the ground floor.
